definitions.explanation: A professional sumo wrestler. Literally 'strong man' or 'man of power.' Used specifically for those competing in professional sumo.

examples.japanese: {力士|りきし}は{毎日|まいにち}{稽古|けいこ}する。
あの{力士|りきし}は{横綱|よこづな}を{目指|めざ}している。
examples.english: That sumo wrestler is aiming to become a yokozuna (grand champion).

notes:
USAGE: {力士|りきし} specifically refers to professional sumo wrestlers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{力士|りきし}の{体|からだ} (a sumo wrestler's body)
・{人気|にんき}{力士|りきし} (popular sumo wrestler)
・{外国人|がいこくじん}{力士|りきし} (foreign sumo wrestler)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{相撲取|すもうと}り (sumo wrestler - colloquial)
・{関取|せきとり} (ranked sumo wrestler)
